source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas — Central Mountains

quote.zh: 有兽焉，其状如白鹿而四角，名曰夫诸，见则其邑大水。
quote.en: There is a beast shaped like a white deer with four antlers, called Fuzhu. Where it is seen, the town floods.

zh: 那天傍晚，风是从北边来的。
泗水上的雾本是灰的，忽然一寸一寸白下去，白得发亮，像有人在雾后头点了一盏灯。
河水停了。不是退，是停——浪头悬在半空，一滴也不落。
雾里先是一个影子，比渡口的老槐还高。然后你看清了：一头白鹿，立在水面上，四只角向天分开，像一棵冬天的树。
它低下头看你。它每迈一步，脚下的水便涨一尺——
水墙扑上岸来，把你拍进了芦苇丛里。你从泥里爬起来，吐出一口河水。
en: That evening the wind came from the north.
The mist on the Si had been grey. Now, inch by inch, it whitened — bright, as if someone had lit a lamp behind it.
The river stopped. Not ebbing: stopped — the crest of a wave hung in the air, and not a drop fell.
First a shadow in the mist, taller than the old locust tree at the crossing. Then you saw it: a white deer standing on the water, four antlers branching to the sky like a tree in winter.
It lowered its head to look at you. With every step it took, the water under it rose a foot —
A wall of water came up the bank and threw you into the reeds. You crawl out of the mud and spit out a mouthful of river.

creatures._appear: The first meeting, played in full on the stage (scripts/cards.js appear): the world turns first, a shadow before the body, the hero struck, then the classic `quote` settles last. Later meetings show one line.

look.zh: 白鹿，头生四角。
look.en: A white deer with four antlers.

open.en: Where my antlers point, the town floods.

won.zh: 水退了。吾归山去，不扰此邑。
won.en: The water falls back. I go to the hills and spare this town.

lost.zh: 见吾者，其邑大水，汝亦然。
lost.en: Whoever sees me, their town floods. Yours as well.

source.en: The Old Classic of Mountains and Rivers (as recorded by Li Gongzuo; Taiping Guangji, juan 467)

quote.zh: 禹理水……获淮涡水神，名无支祁……形若猿猴，缩鼻高额，青躯白首，金目雪牙，颈伸百尺，力逾九象……颈锁大索，鼻穿金铃，徙淮阴之龟山之足下，俾淮水永安流注海也。
quote.en: When Yu was taming the waters he took the water god of the Huai and the Guo, named Wuzhiqi — shaped like an ape, snub-nosed and high-browed, with a blue-green body and a white head, golden eyes and snow-white teeth; its neck stretched a hundred feet and its strength was more than nine elephants'. Its neck was bound with a great rope, a golden bell hung through its nose, and it was moved to the foot of Mount Gui at Huaiyin, so that the Huai might flow at peace into the sea for ever.

look.zh: 猿猴的样子，青身白头，金眼雪牙；脖子能伸出百尺。
look.en: An ape's shape, a blue-green body and a white head, golden eyes and snow-white teeth; its neck can stretch a hundred feet.

open.zh: 禹锁过吾颈，汝又凭什么？
open.en: Yu once chained my neck. What have you got?

won.zh: 金铃又响了……淮水，归你们。
won.en: The golden bell rings again… Keep your Huai, then.

lost.en: If you cannot chain me, get off the Huai.

source.en: Discourses of the States — Lu, part two

quote.zh: 吴伐越，堕会稽，获骨焉，节专车。吴子使来好聘，且问之仲尼……仲尼曰：丘闻之：昔禹致群神于会稽之山，防风氏后至，禹杀而戮之，其骨节专车。此为大矣。
quote.en: Wu attacked Yue, razed Kuaiji and found a bone there, one joint of which filled a cart. The lord of Wu sent an envoy, who asked Confucius. Confucius said: I have heard that of old Yu called the spirits together on Mount Kuaiji; Fangfeng came late, and Yu put him to death. One joint of his bones filled a cart. That is the greatest of bones.

look.zh: 巨人，一节骨头就要一辆车来装；夜夜往会稽走，总也走不到。
look.en: A giant, one joint of whose bones would fill a cart; every night he walks toward Kuaiji and never arrives.

open.zh: 会稽还远么？莫挡吾的路。
open.en: Is Kuaiji still far? Do not stand in my road.

won.zh: 又迟了……如当年会稽之会。
won.en: Late again… as I was on Kuaiji, long ago.

lost.en: This time, you are the one who came late.

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas — Southern Mountains II

quote.zh: 长右之山，无草木，多水。有兽焉，其状如禺而四耳，其名长右，其音如吟，见则郡县大水。
quote.en: Mount Changyou has no grass or trees, and much water. There is a beast on it like a long-tailed ape with four ears, called Changyou; its cry is a moan, and where it is seen the commanderies and counties flood.

look.zh: 长尾猿的样子，四只耳朵；叫声像人在低吟。
look.en: A long-tailed ape with four ears; its cry is like someone moaning low.

open.en: Hear my low chant, and every county floods.

won.en: My chant falls quiet, and the water with it.

lost.en: Did you hear the chant clearly?

quote.zh: 巴蛇食象，三岁而出其骨，君子服之，无心腹之疾。其为蛇青黄赤黑。
quote.en: The Ba snake eats elephants and gives up their bones after three years; a gentleman who takes it suffers no illness of heart or belly. It is a snake of green, yellow, red and black.

look.zh: 一条大蛇，青、黄、赤、黑四色，吞得下一头象。
look.en: A great snake patterned green, yellow, red and black, able to swallow an elephant.

open.en: I have swallowed elephants. You would not fill a tooth.

won.zh: 罢了，吾盘回去慢慢消食。
won.en: Enough. I will coil back and digest in peace.

lost.en: Swallowed slowly; the bones come out in time.

quote.zh: 又东南二百里，曰即公之山……有兽焉，其状如龟，而白身赤首，名曰蛫，是可以御火。
quote.en: Two hundred li further south-east is Mount Jigong… There is a beast on it like a turtle, white-bodied and red-headed, called Gui; it can ward off fire.

look.zh: 龟的样子，白身子，红脑袋。
look.en: A turtle's shape, a white body and a red head.

open.zh: 吾缩甲中，火不能侵，汝亦不能。
open.en: In my shell, fire cannot reach me. Nor can you.

won.en: My shell cracks… I will make way.

lost.en: The shell holds. Your strength does not.

quote.zh: 又东北三百里，曰岷山。江水出焉……其兽多犀象，多夔牛。（郭璞注：今蜀山中有大牛，重数千斤，名为夔牛。）
quote.en: Three hundred li further north-east is Mount Min, where the Jiang rises… its beasts are many rhinoceroses and elephants, and many Kui oxen. (Guo Pu: in the hills of Shu today there is a great ox weighing several thousand jin, called the Kui ox.)

look.zh: 一头大牛，重有千斤，身子像一座小山。
look.en: A great ox a thousand jin in weight, its body like a small hill.

open.zh: 岷山是吾的，汝踩着吾的草。
open.en: Min Mountain is mine. You are treading my grass.

won.en: Moo… Back to Min Mountain to graze.

lost.en: I can shove a mountain, let alone you.

quote.zh: 又东北一百五十里，曰崌山……有鸟焉，状如鸮而赤身白首，其名曰窃脂，可以御火。
quote.en: A hundred and fifty li further north-east is Mount Ju… There is a bird on it like an owl, red-bodied and white-headed, called Qiezhi; it can ward off fire.

look.zh: 鸮的样子，红身子，白脑袋。
look.en: An owl's shape, a red body and a white head.

open.en: Where my red feathers fall, even fire goes around.

won.en: My feathers are ruffled… Back to Mount Ju I fly.

lost.zh: 汝连吾的影子也没碰着。
lost.en: You never touched so much as my shadow.

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas — Western Mountains

quote.zh: 又西六十里，曰太华之山，削成而四方，其高五千仞，其广十里，鸟兽莫居。有蛇焉，名曰肥遗，六足四翼，见则天下大旱。
quote.en: Sixty li further west is Mount Taihua, cut square on four sides, five thousand ren high and ten li broad; neither bird nor beast lives there. There is a snake on it called Feiyi, with six legs and four wings; where it is seen, the world suffers great drought.

look.zh: 一条蛇，六只脚，四只翅膀。
look.en: A snake with six legs and four wings.

open.zh: 吾出，则天下大旱。汝渴么？
open.en: When I come out, the whole land goes dry. Thirsty?

won.en: Rain is coming… I go back to Taihua.

lost.en: Let the drought sink into your bones.

creatures._signature: 六足四翼 —— 翅膀一扇，阵前的都焦了，火落到你身上。

quote.zh: 西山经华山之首，曰钱来之山，其上多松，其下多洗石。有兽焉，其状如羊而马尾，名曰羬羊，其脂可以已腊。
quote.en: The first of the Western Mountains, at the head of the Hua range, is Mount Qianlai, with many pines above and many scouring-stones below. There is a beast on it like a goat with a horse's tail, called Qianyang; its fat heals chapped skin.

look.zh: 羊的样子，长着马的尾巴。
look.en: A goat's shape with a horse's tail.

open.zh: 钱来山的羊，没那么好欺。
open.en: The sheep of Qianlai Mountain is not easily bullied.

won.en: Baa… Take it. My fat heals cracked skin.

lost.en: My hide is thick. Can you still wear it down?

creatures._signature: 其脂可以已腊 —— 它把伤口一抹，又站直了。

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas — Central Mountains III

quote.zh: 又东二十里，曰和山，其上无草木而多瑶碧，实惟河之九都。是山也五曲，九水出焉，合而北流注于河……吉神泰逢司之，其状如人而虎尾，是好居于萯山之阳，出入有光。泰逢神动天地气也。
quote.en: Twenty li further east is Mount He, bare of grass and trees and rich in jade; it is truly the Nine Confluences of the River. The mountain winds five times, and nine streams rise on it, join, and flow north into the River… The auspicious god Taifeng rules it, shaped like a man with a tiger's tail; he likes to dwell on the sunny side of Mount Bei, and there is light when he goes in and out. The god Taifeng stirs the breath of heaven and earth.

look.zh: 人的样子，老虎的尾巴；出入身上有光。
look.en: A man's shape with a tiger's tail; light goes with him in and out.

open.en: I keep He Mountain. What do you seek here?

won.en: Good. Heaven and earth let you pass, for now.

lost.zh: 天地之气动了，汝站得住么？
lost.en: Heaven and earth stir. Can you still stand?

creatures._signature: 泰逢神动天地气也 —— 他一动，阵前的都晃，天地的气压到你身上。

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas — Central Mountains II

quote.zh: 又西二百里，曰蔓渠之山，其上多金玉，其下多竹箭。伊水出焉，而东流注于洛。有兽焉，其名曰马腹，其状如人面虎身，其音如婴儿，是食人。
quote.en: Two hundred li further west is Mount Manqu, with much gold and jade above and arrow-bamboo below. The Yi rises there and flows east into the Luo. There is a beast on it called Mafu, with a human face and a tiger's body; its cry is like an infant's, and it eats people.

look.zh: 人的脸，老虎的身子；叫起来像婴儿。
look.en: A human face on a tiger's body; its cry is like an infant's.

open.zh: 呜哇……过来些，让吾看清汝。
open.en: Waah… Come closer, let me see you.

won.en: Hnn… I will stop crying. Go.

lost.zh: 汝循着哭声来，便该想到。
lost.en: You followed the crying. You should have known.

quote.zh: 钩吾之山有兽焉，其状如羊身人面，其目在腋下，虎齿人爪，其音如婴儿，名曰狍鸮，是食人。
quote.en: On Mount Gouwu is a beast with a sheep's body and a human face, its eyes under its arms, tiger's teeth and human nails; it cries like an infant. It is called Paoxiao, and it eats people.

look.zh: 羊身人面，目在腋下。
look.en: A sheep's body with a human face, eyes under the arms.

open.en: My eyes are under my arms. You cannot hide.

won.en: Hungry… still hungry… I will go.

lost.en: Even with you swallowed, I am still hungry.

quote.zh: 发鸠之山有鸟焉，其状如乌，文首、白喙、赤足，名曰精卫。是炎帝之少女，游于东海，溺而不返，故为精卫，常衔西山之木石，以堙于东海。
quote.en: On Mount Fajiu is a bird like a crow, with a patterned head, white beak and red feet, called Jingwei. She was the Flame Emperor's youngest daughter, drowned in the Eastern Sea; now she carries twigs and stones from the western hills to fill it.

look.zh: 花头白喙赤足的小鸟，衔着石子。
look.en: A small bird, patterned head, white beak, red feet, a pebble in its beak.

open.en: Do not stop me. The Eastern Sea is not yet filled.

won.en: I dropped my pebble… I will fetch another.

lost.en: I would fill a sea. Why would I fear you?

quote.zh: 雷泽中有雷神，龙身而人头，鼓其腹。在吴西。
quote.en: In Lake Lei there is a Thunder God, with a dragon's body and a man's head; it drums on its belly. It lies west of Wu.

look.zh: 龙的身子，人的头，两只手拍着自己的肚子；每拍一下，天上响一声雷。
look.en: A dragon's body and a man's head, both hands beating its own belly; every beat, a crack of thunder in the sky.

open.zh: 雷泽是吾的鼓。汝要听响么？
open.en: Thunder Marsh is my drum. Care to hear it?

won.en: The drum falls silent. Cross Thunder Marsh.

lost.en: That thunder was drummed for you.

quote.en: On Mount Fuli there is a beast like a fox, with nine tails, nine heads and a tiger's claws, called Longzhi; it sounds like an infant, and it eats people.

look.zh: 狐的身子，九条尾巴，九个头，虎的爪子；叫起来像婴儿哭。
look.en: A fox's body with nine tails, nine heads and a tiger's claws; its cry is an infant's.

open.zh: 头头都饿了，汝先喂哪个？
open.en: Every head is hungry. Which will you feed first?

won.zh: 尾巴都垂了……吾回凫丽山。
won.en: All my tails droop… Back to Fuli Mountain.

lost.en: Could you ever cut off all my heads?

zh: 山门外的林子里，放着一只妖兽。
一根锁链，拴在一棵古松上。锁链那头，有什么在动。
九个脑袋，九条尾巴，虎一样的爪子。
九个脑袋一齐转过来，盯着每一个走进林子的孩子——
它叫了。九个声音，像九个婴儿一齐在哭。
en: In the woods outside the gate, a demon beast has been set loose.
A chain, fastened to an ancient pine. At the other end of it, something moves.
Nine heads, nine tails, claws like a tiger's.
All nine heads turn at once to stare at every child who walks into the woods —
It cries. Nine voices, like nine infants wailing together.

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas — The Great Wilderness, East

quote.zh: 东海中有流波山，入海七千里。其上有兽，状如牛，苍身而无角，一足，出入水则必风雨，其光如日月，其声如雷，其名曰夔。黄帝得之，以其皮为鼓。
quote.en: In the East Sea lies Mount Liubo, seven thousand li out. On it is a beast like an ox, blue-grey and hornless, with one foot; when it goes in or out of the water there is wind and rain; its light is like the sun and moon, its voice like thunder. Its name is Kui. The Yellow Emperor took it and made a drum of its hide.

look.zh: 牛的样子，青苍的身子，没有角，一条腿；光像日月，声如雷。
look.en: An ox's shape, a blue-grey body, no horns, one leg; its light like the sun and moon, its voice like thunder.

open.en: When I go in or out of the water, wind and rain follow.

won.zh: 雷声远了……莫拿吾皮做鼓。
won.en: The thunder fades… Do not make a drum of my hide.

lost.zh: 黄帝才制得住吾，汝不是。
lost.en: Only the Yellow Emperor could master me. You are not he.

creatures._signature: 其声如雷 —— 一足落地，整片阵前都在抖。

quote.zh: 泰山……有兽焉，其状如豚而有珠，名曰狪狪，其鸣自訆。
quote.en: On Mount Tai there is a beast like a pig that carries a pearl, called Tongtong; its cry is its own name.

look.zh: 猪的样子，嘴里含着一颗珠；叫起来像在叫自己的名字。
look.en: A pig's shape with a pearl in its mouth; its cry is its own name.

open.en: Tong-tong! Tong-tong! The pearl is mine!

won.en: Tong… The pearl is still here. I am off.

lost.zh: 狪狪！谁也拿不走吾的珠！
lost.en: Tong-tong! No one takes my pearl!

quote.en: On Mount Zhang'e … there is a beast like a red leopard, with five tails and one horn; its voice is like struck stone, and its name is Zheng.

look.zh: 像一只赤豹，五条尾巴，头上一只独角；叫起来像敲石头。眼前这只，像一只吃撑了的红毛团子。
look.en: Like a red leopard with five tails and a single horn; its cry is like stone struck on stone. This one looks more like an overfed ball of red fur.

open.en: (Crunch. Crunch.)

won.en: (A hiccup.)

lost.en: (It runs off with the herb in its mouth.)

runs.en: You barely raise a hand and the ball of red fur shoots into the herbs and is gone. The token on your chest flares, and a very sleepy voice: "…Why fight it? Did you bring a radish or not."

name.en: The silver fox in the pit

look.zh: 一身银毛，一条尾巴，尾根上八处断口；金色的眼睛，瞳仁竖着。
look.en: Silver fur, one tail, eight clean stumps at its root; gold eyes, slit pupils.

open.en: (It bares its teeth; a small, fierce whimper in its throat.)

won.en: (It stops biting. It buries its face in the patch.)

lost.en: (It can't even lift its head; it only watches you.)

creatures._about: 第一回's teaching fight (2026-10-22, Hanli: 「你说的1-6 都是好主意, 按你说的改一遍. 关键是能留住玩家」): 00-fox, 「他爹说过，受伤的野兽最凶，碰都别去碰」 — he goes to it anyway, and it bites. look.zh: 瘦高个，腿在抖；腰上系着他娘缝的护身符。
look.en: Tall and skinny, legs shaking; at his waist, the charm his mother sewed.

open.zh: 咱俩……都是下下之资……你……你手下留情……
open.en: We're both… the bottom of the class… go… go easy on me…

won.en: …I—I lost after all.

lost.en: I… I won?

look.zh: 一身新法衣，腰里挂着那面铜镜——穿白的仙长留给他爹的。
look.en: A new robe, and at his waist that bronze mirror — the one the man in white left with his father.

open.zh: 你跪下，叫三声爷爷，我让你滚下去。
open.en: Kneel, call me grandpa three times, and I'll let you crawl off.

won.en: My—my father is—

lost.en: See? That's what knowing your place looks like.

look.zh: 内门的练气六层，三十出头，一张长脸，眼皮总耷拉着；外门熬了九年才进的内门，熬白了半头头发，最见不得外门的人往台上爬。金刃削脚，土墙挤人。
look.en: Layer six of Qi Condensation in the inner court, a little past thirty, long-faced, eyelids always drooping; nine years grinding in the outer court before he made the inner, and half his hair went white for it — he can't bear to see an outer disciple climb onto the stage. A metal blade at your ankles, an earth wall to crowd you off.

open.zh: 外门的，一个比一个不知道天高地厚。
open.en: Outer court — each one knows less of heaven and earth than the last.

won.en: …Outer court?

lost.en: Get down.

won.zh: 掉下台的，输。规矩上，就是输了。
won.en: Off the stage, you lose. By the rules, I've lost.

lost.en: I told you: I won't give way.

creatures._trial: 三十招 (古六, 2026-10-03 book: her sword and ice spikes for thirty moves, then the edge — he takes the thrust through his left arm, seizes her scabbard, she lands off the stage first). A 试 passed by outlasting her twelve cards (battle.js § trial), no yield — the edge is the story's. look.en: A yellow robe of the Red Pine Abbey at Pengcheng, layer nine of Qi Condensation; pale-faced, always smiling. In his right hand a red-copper gourd that looses fire snakes; on his left arm a little red-copper shield chased with flames — nothing short of Core Formation can break it, his brothers say.

won.zh: 你这踏马的符是哪来的！？
won.en: Where the hell did you get that hell-for-leather charm!?

lost.en: Nothing short of Core Formation can break it.

goal.zh: 被追着打：他有一面盾，结丹以下，无人能破——打不穿他。撑到他出完每一招，便算过了。
goal.en: Chased and beaten: his shield, they say, nothing short of Core Formation can break — you will not get through it. Last until he has spent every move, and you have passed.

creatures._trial: 古五 (the author, 2026-10-02: 「九死一生，被追着打……最后是银月出手」): a 试 passed by outlasting his twelve cards (battle.js § trial), no yield — he is never driven down; the turn is the story's (the exit: the leap onto the 蛫, 银月's two hairs break the shield, he finishes it). node tools/trial-sim.mjs foe-zou --at.

look.zh: 内门的练气九层圆满，五年大比的决赛就是他。一上台便是全力，金刃一道接一道——发一道，喘一口，跟当年的卢方一样。
look.en: Inner court, layer nine and full — the final of the fifth year's contest. All his strength from the first moment, metal blades one after another: one blade, one breath, just like Lu Fang years ago.

open.en: Please.

won.en: I yield.

lost.en: Get down.

creatures.art_source: The iron sword's picture (as 卢方's) until his portrait is painted.

creatures._signature: 第十一道 —— 一身的灵力全在刃上（古八，09-dabi 的决赛）；小满的火柴进的是那一口喘。
creatures._person: Not a people.json row (the book never names him; no portrait yet): `title` 比试 keeps the fight card a bout, never 降妖. The 腊八 大比's final in 古八 (09-dabi/dabi), the first bout and the three between told.

look.zh: 河伯脚下的两条青龙，鳞片有磨盘那么大；一条扑，一条扫。
look.en: The two blue dragons under the River Lord's feet, scales as big as millstones; one lunges, one sweeps.

quote.zh: 冰夷人面，乘两龙。
quote.en: Bingyi has a human face and rides two dragons.

open.en: The one who stands while all kneel: we test you.

won.en: You did not step aside. Enough.

lost.en: Kneel, mortal.

goal.zh: 这是试，不是斗：撑到双龙出完招，或把它们逼到三成气血，便算过了。
goal.en: A trial, not a fight: stand until the dragons have spent every move, or drive them down to a third, and you have passed.

creatures._trial: 试 (battle.js § trial): the dragons yield at 35% of their 气血, and a player still standing when their twelve are spent has passed — not a withdrawal. Weighed with the deck the road deals by 古十 (tools/trial-sim.mjs): a careful line wins ~99%, a careless one ~47%; before, the careful line won 74% and ran dry into 遁走 7% of fights (2026-09-30).
creatures._deck: 冰夷双龙 —— 一扑一扫，水里来，水里去；是来试人的，不是来杀人的（古十）。
creatures._signature: 双龙摆尾 —— 两条尾巴贴着河滩一齐扫过来。

look.zh: 太一宫的白衣执事，筑基大成，在筑基上卡了三十年。一张白得看不出年纪的脸，手里托着一面铜镜，镜面朝上，像托着一碗水。他站过的浅水里，水草直直地立起来，像插在冰里。
look.en: A white-robed steward of the Taiyi Palace, Foundation complete — stuck at the Foundation thirty years. A face too white to show an age, a bronze mirror held face up in one hand like a bowl of water. Where he stands in the shallows the reeds stand straight up, as if set in ice.

quote.zh: 嗓子还是那口老井。
quote.en: The voice was still that old well.

open.en: Found you.

won.en: This entry is written down.

lost.en: No one is guarding you.

creatures._deck: 老井 —— 一根指头（寒潭指，六张），点断过他的肋骨，点断过一棵柳树；一整只手掌平平推过来，嘴唇动一动（潮起、停波 ×2、冰锥符 ×2、冰锥）。筑基大成，十二张里没有一张是守的：他不护身，那一层光就是他的护身（古九）。
creatures._signature: 镜光 —— 他把那面铜镜翻过来，一道冷光不打人，直奔胸口，奔木牌去（古九）。

goal.zh: 他是筑基大成，你打不穿他那一层光。躲开那根指头，撑到他出完每一招——阿禾还蹲在岸边。
goal.en: He is Foundation complete; you will not get through that layer of light. Dodge the finger and last until he has spent every move — Ahe is still crouched by the water.

quote.zh: 爹说：野猪不怕人，怕的是人先看见它。先看风，后看猪。
quote.en: Father says: a boar is not afraid of people — it is afraid of being seen first. Wind first, then the boar.

look.en: Black bristles, tusks curling up, a hide caked in mud like armour; once it charges, it does not turn.

open.en: Hrnk — hrnk —

won.en: It wheels and crashes back into the trees.

lost.en: It knocks you flat and trots off.

quote.en: A wolf's howl comes from the chest, and it is warm; the wind has only a hole, and however loud, it is hollow.

look.zh: 灰背，眼睛在暗处发绿。一只在前头，几只在你看不见的地方。
look.en: Grey-backed, eyes green in the dark. One in front of you, and a few where you cannot see.

open.en: Aooo —

won.en: The pack melts back into the pines.

lost.zh: 它们围着你转了一圈，走了。

quote.en: Two years ago a bear took Qin Yan's father by the leg; he has been abed ever since.

look.zh: 人立起来比门框还高，一掌能拍断碗口粗的树。
look.en: Standing up it is taller than a door frame; one swipe snaps a tree as thick as a bowl.

open.en: Rrraugh —

won.zh: 它放下前掌，慢吞吞走开了。
won.en: It drops to all fours and lumbers away.

lost.zh: 它一掌把你拍进了草窠。
lost.en: One swipe and you are in the bushes.

quote.zh: 又东北二百里，曰马成之山，其上多文石，其阴多金玉。有兽焉，其状如白犬而黑头，见人则飞，其名曰天马，其鸣自訆。
quote.en: Two hundred li further north-east is Mount Macheng… There is a beast on it like a white dog with a black head; when it sees a man it flies. It is called Tianma, and it calls its own name.

look.zh: 白狗的身子，黑脑袋。一见人，便腾空飞起来。
look.en: A white dog's body and a black head. The moment it sees a man, it takes to the air.

open.en: Tianma! Tianma!

won.zh: 它叫着自己的名字，飞过山脊去了。
won.en: Calling its own name, it flies off over the ridge.

lost.zh: 它在你头顶转了一圈，飞走了。
lost.en: It circles once over your head and flies away.

quote.en: …called Mount Yang, with jade above and gold and copper below. There is a beast on it like an ox with a red tail and a hump at its neck like a bent measure; it is called Linghu, it cries its own name, and eating it cures madness.

look.zh: 牛的样子，一条红尾巴，脖子上鼓着一个大肉包。
look.en: Shaped like an ox, with a red tail and a great lump swelling at its neck.

open.en: Linghu — Linghu —

won.zh: 它甩着红尾巴，回山里去了。
won.en: Switching its red tail, it goes back into the hills.

lost.zh: 它一头把你顶翻，哞了一声。
lost.en: It butts you over and bellows once.

quote.en: Two hundred li further north is Mount Longhou… The Juejue rises there and flows east into the River. In it are many renyu, like the ti fish, with four legs and a voice like a baby's; eating one keeps the wits.

look.zh: 鱼的身子，四只脚，在浅水里爬。夜里叫起来，像婴儿哭。
look.en: A fish's body on four legs, crawling in the shallows. At night it cries like a baby.

open.en: Waah — waah —

won.zh: 它扑通一声滑回了水里。
won.en: With a splash it slides back into the water.

lost.zh: 它在水边哭了一夜，你没能近身。
lost.en: It cries by the water all night; you never get close.

quote.zh: 又东北二百里，曰剡山，多金玉。有兽焉，其状如彘而人面，黄身而赤尾，其名曰合窳，其音如婴儿。是兽也，食人，亦食虫蛇，见则天下大水。
quote.en: Two hundred li further north-east is Mount Shan, rich in gold and jade. There is a beast on it like a pig with a human face, yellow-bodied and red-tailed, called Heyu; its voice is like a baby's. It eats men, and eats insects and snakes too; where it is seen, the land floods.

look.zh: 一头比牛还大的彘，黄毛，红尾巴拖在身后像一条火；那张脸是人的，像谁都像，像谁都不像。哭起来像娃娃。
look.en: A pig bigger than an ox, yellow-haired, a red tail dragging behind like a trail of fire; the face is a man's — like everyone, like no one. It cries like a baby.

open.en: The crying is the bait. You are the fish.

won.zh: 它拖着那张人脸，滚进坑里不动了。
won.en: It drags its human face into the pit and lies still.

lost.en: The crying stops. So do you.

quote.zh: 又南三百八十里，曰余峨之山。有兽焉，其状如菟而鸟喙，鸱目蛇尾，见人则眠，名曰犰狳，其鸣自訆，见则螽蝗为败。
quote.en: Three hundred and eighty li further south is Mount Yu'e. There is a beast on it like a hare with a bird's beak, an owl's eyes and a snake's tail; when it sees a man it sleeps. It is called Qiuyu, it calls its own name, and where it is seen, locusts ruin the crops.

look.zh: 兔子大小，鸟嘴，一双猫头鹰的圆眼，拖一条蛇尾巴；人一走近，它便倒下装死。
look.en: Rabbit-sized, with a bird's beak, round owl's eyes and a snake's tail; the moment anyone comes near, it falls over and plays dead.

open.en: (It shuts its eyes and rolls belly-up.)

won.en: It opens one owl's eye and slips away.

lost.zh: 它还睡着——你的人已经倒了。
lost.en: It is still asleep — and your people are down.

name.en: It Sleeps at the Sight of Men

feint._about: 装睡 (battle.js § asleep): its first two turns it lies still; a blow not of metal glances (lands 1) and is counted; 金克木 — metal goes in whole (小满 coats 火柴 in metal light), and so does every blow of a turn in which a bind was played at it (`pierce_binds`: 阿禾 binds it, 小满 strikes). It wakes with 鸱目一睁, 3 harder for every blow that glanced.

creatures._signature: 鸱目一睁 —— 装死的眼睁开：鸟喙一啄，蛇尾贴地三抽（锄把上一个印子，小满小腿上三道）。每一下白打在它身上的，醒来多还三分。
creatures._book: 古七 (Hanli 2026-10-06; level fixed Hanli 2026-10-08): the first 执事堂 errand (年三秋, 灵草谷): layer six, not yet awakened (a 5-layer team of three needs a monster at least layer five, set at six; no 灵智 holds its fighting power down); it plays dead; (the locust-and-burnt-turf thread was cut 2026-10-08) wood-natured, so metal beats it — 阿禾 sees its spirit-power and binds it with vines, 小满 coats his 火柴 with a layer of metal spirit-light (sharper, cuts the beak) and kills it asleep, 小满 kills it asleep (「这一场，不算」). Not yet a game scene (listed for later); not in any pool. 2026-10-16 (Hanli): 见人则眠 is 假睡 — an ambush, never a heal. The fight is 装睡 for two turns (plain blows glance), then 鸱目一睁; a careless player loses it, 「赢得难看」.

quote.zh: 爹说：狐狸走过的雪，后脚踩进前脚的窝，一行脚印像一个人走的。看见一行，别当是一只。
quote.en: Father says: a fox in snow sets its hind foot in its forefoot's print, so the line looks like one walker. See one line — don't count one fox.

look.zh: 一身火红，尾巴尖一点白。叼了东西就跑，跑几步还回头看你。
look.en: Fire-red all over, a white tip to the tail. It snatches and runs, and a few steps on it looks back at you.

open.en: (A herb in its jaws, it looks back at you.)

won.en: (It drops the herb and is gone into the pines.)

lost.en: (Herb in its jaws, it ambles away.)

quote.zh: 爹说：山狸子夜里下山，偷鸡不叫鸡出声。鸡窝里一声也没有，才是它来过。
quote.en: Father says: the leopard cat comes down at night and takes a hen without a squawk. A coop gone quiet is the sign it called.

look.zh: 比家猫大一圈，灰褐的毛上一身铜钱斑，眼上两道白。夜里只看得见两点绿光。
look.en: A size bigger than a house cat, grey-brown, spotted like strings of coins, two white streaks over the eyes. At night you see only two points of green.

open.en: (Two points of green in the dark, unblinking.)

won.en: (The green goes out; not a blade of grass stirs.)

lost.en: (It springs over your shoulder and is gone.)

source.en: A Mount Meng hunter's trade

quote.zh: 爹说：猴子学人。你蹲下，它也蹲下。别跟它比耐性，它比你闲。
quote.en: Father says: a monkey copies a man. You squat, it squats. Don't try to out-wait it; it has less to do than you.

look.zh: 红脸，黄毛，一只手攥着从药园顺来的草，一只手挠头。后头树上还蹲着一群。
look.en: Red face, tawny fur, one hand clutching a herb filched from the garden, the other scratching its head. More of them squat in the tree behind.

open.en: Ee — ee-ee!

won.en: (The whole tree of monkeys scatters at once.)

lost.zh: （它朝你龇牙，捡起你掉的东西跑了。）
lost.en: (It bares its teeth at you, picks up what you dropped, and runs.)

quote.zh: 爹说：进草窠先拿棍子打一打。蝮蛇不让路，它等你一脚踩上去。
quote.en: Father says: beat the grass with a stick before you walk in. A pit viper won't give way — it waits for your foot.

look.zh: 短，粗，褐底黑斑，三角脑袋。盘在石头上像一截烂绳，一动不动。
look.en: Short and thick, dark bands on brown, a triangular head. Coiled on the stone like a length of rotten rope, perfectly still.

open.en: Ssss —

won.en: (It uncoils and slides into a crack in the rock.)

lost.en: (One bite, and it coils back on its stone.)

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas — Eastern Mountains

quote.zh: 又南三百里，曰栒状之山，其上多金玉，其下多青碧石。有兽焉，其状如犬，六足，其名曰从从，其鸣自詨。
quote.en: Three hundred li further south is Mount Xunzhuang, rich in gold and jade above and blue-green stone below. There is a beast on it like a dog with six feet. It is called Congcong, and it calls its own name.

look.zh: 一条狗，六只脚。跑起来脚多得数不过来，叫起来叫的是自己的名字。
look.en: A dog with six feet. Running, it has more legs than you can count; barking, it barks its own name.

open.en: Congcong! Congcong!

won.zh: 它叫着自己的名字，六只脚一齐跑远了。
won.en: Calling its own name, it runs off on all six feet.

lost.zh: 从从！——它绕着你跑了三圈。
lost.en: Congcong! — it runs three rings round you.

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas — Eastern Mountains II

quote.zh: 又南三百八十里，曰䃌山，南临䃌水，东望湖泽……有鸟焉，其状如凫而鼠尾，善登木，其名曰絜钩，见则其国多疫。
quote.en: Three hundred and eighty li further south is Mount Gao, over the Gao river, looking east to the lakes… There is a bird like a wild duck with a rat's tail; it climbs trees well. It is called Xiegou. Where it is seen, the land has much sickness.

look.zh: 野鸭的身子，拖一条老鼠尾巴，却会爬树。蹲在枝头，底下的草一片一片发黄。
look.en: A wild duck's body trailing a rat's tail — and it climbs trees. Where it perches, the grass below goes yellow patch by patch.

open.en: (A sound in the tree, like a cough.)

won.zh: （它拖着鼠尾，爬上树梢不见了。）
won.en: (Trailing its rat's tail, it climbs out of sight.)

lost.en: (You cough once. It watches from the tree.)

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas — Eastern Mountains II

quote.zh: 又南四百里，曰空桑之山，北临食水，东望沮吴，南望沙陵，西望湣泽。有兽焉，其状如牛而虎文，其音如钦，其名曰軨軨，其鸣自叫，见则天下大水。
quote.en: Four hundred li further south is Mount Kongsang, over the Shi river… There is a beast on it like an ox with a tiger's stripes; its voice is a groan. It is called Lingling and calls its own name. Where it is seen, the world floods.

look.zh: 一头牛，身上却是老虎的纹。叫声闷闷的，像有人在水底下叹气。
look.en: An ox, striped like a tiger. Its cry is muffled, like someone sighing under water.

open.en: Lingling — lingling —

won.zh: 它叫着自己的名字，往空桑那边去了。
won.en: Calling its own name, it goes off toward Kongsang.

lost.zh: 軨軨——脚底下的地，渗出水来。
lost.en: Lingling — water seeps up from the ground at your feet.

source.en: A Mount Meng hunter's trade

quote.zh: 爹说：天上一个黑点不动，那就是鹰。兔子没看见它，你也没看见它，它两个都看见了。
quote.en: Father says: a black dot in the sky that doesn't move — that's the hawk. The hare hasn't seen it, you haven't seen it, and it has seen you both.

look.zh: 青灰的背，胸前一道道横纹，眼睛黄得发亮。收了翅膀往下扎，像一块石头。
look.en: Slate-grey back, barred breast, eyes a bright hard yellow. Wings folded, it drops like a stone.

open.en: (A long scream from the cliff top.)

won.en: (One beat of its wings, and it slants away down the cliff.)

lost.zh: （爪子擦过你的头皮，它又上了天。）
lost.en: (Its talons graze your scalp, and it is back in the sky.)

quote.zh: 又南水行七百里，曰尸胡之山，北望𡺳山，其上多金玉，其下多棘。有兽焉，其状如麋而鱼目，名曰妴胡，其鸣自訆。
quote.en: Seven hundred li further south by water is Mount Shihu… rich in gold and jade above and thorn below. There is a beast on it like an elk with a fish's eyes. It is called Yuanhu, and it calls its own name.

look.zh: 一头麋鹿，眼睛却是鱼的——圆，鼓，不会眨。你走到哪边，它那只眼就跟到哪边。
look.en: An elk — with a fish's eyes: round, bulging, lidless. Wherever you step, that eye follows.

open.en: Yuanhu — yuanhu —

won.zh: 它叫着自己的名字，跃进荆棘丛里。
won.en: Calling its own name, it leaps into the thorns.

lost.en: Yuanhu — the fish eye is still on you.

quote.zh: 又南水行九百里，曰踇隅之山，其上多草木，多金玉，多赭。有兽焉，其状如牛而马尾，名曰精精，其鸣自訆。
quote.en: Nine hundred li further south by water is Mount Muyu, thick with grass and trees, rich in gold, jade and ochre. There is a beast on it like an ox with a horse's tail. It is called Jingjing, and it calls its own name.

look.zh: 牛的身子，后头甩着一条马尾巴。低下头的时候，两只角正对着你。
look.en: An ox's body swinging a horse's tail. When it lowers its head, both horns point straight at you.

open.en: Jingjing! Jingjing!

won.zh: 它甩着马尾，叫着自己的名字走了。
won.en: Swishing its horse's tail, it walks off calling its own name.

lost.zh: 精精！——它把你顶进了草里。
lost.en: Jingjing! — it butts you into the grass.

source.en: A Mount Meng hunter's trade

quote.zh: 爹说：豺狗子不单走。一只在前头逗你，几只绕到后头掏你。听见前头有动静，先看后头。
quote.en: Father says: dholes never hunt alone. One teases you from the front while the rest circle behind to rip at you. Hear something ahead — look behind.

look.zh: 比狼小，一身锈红，尾巴黑而蓬。前头那只蹲着不动，草里还有几双眼睛。
look.en: Smaller than a wolf, rust-red, a black brush of a tail. The one in front sits still; there are more eyes in the grass.

open.en: (One in front — and more in the grass.)

won.en: (A short yap, and the red shapes scatter.)

lost.en: (They don't follow; they just watch you go.)

quote.zh: 又南五百里，曰姑逢之山，无草木，多金玉。有兽焉，其状如狐而有翼，其音如鸿雁，其名曰獙獙，见则天下大旱。
quote.en: Five hundred li further south is Mount Gufeng, bare of grass and trees, rich in gold and jade. There is a beast on it like a fox with wings; its cry is a wild goose's. It is called Bibi. Where it is seen, the world goes dry.

look.zh: 狐狸的身子，背上一对翅膀。叫起来像过冬的雁。它落过的地方，草根都焦了。
look.en: A fox's body, a pair of wings on its back. Its cry is a goose going south for the winter. Where it has landed, the grass roots are scorched.

open.zh: （头顶一声雁叫，可天上没有雁。）
open.en: (A goose cries overhead — but there are no geese.)

won.zh: （它展翅往南去了，风里带着焦味。）
won.en: (It spreads its wings and goes south; the wind smells scorched.)

lost.en: (The goose-cry fades. Your lips have cracked with dryness.)

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas — Eastern Mountains IV

quote.zh: 又东南二百里，曰钦山，多金玉而无石……有兽焉，其状如豚而有牙，其名曰当康，其鸣自叫，见则天下大穰。
quote.en: Two hundred li further south-east is Mount Qin, rich in gold and jade but without stone… There is a beast on it like a pig with tusks. It is called Dangkang and calls its own name. Where it is seen, the world has a great harvest.

look.zh: 一头小猪，嘴边两颗獠牙。叫的是自己的名字，听着却像在报喜。
look.en: A young pig with two tusks at its lips. It cries its own name, and it sounds like good news.

open.en: Dangkang! Dangkang!

won.zh: 它拱开一片土，叫着自己的名字跑了。
won.en: It roots up a patch of earth and runs off calling its own name.

lost.zh: 当康！——它在你身边转了一圈，像在道喜。
lost.en: Dangkang! — it trots a ring round you, as if wishing you joy.

quote.zh: 东次四山之首，曰北号之山，临于北海……有兽焉，其状如狼，赤首鼠目，其音如豚，名曰猲狙，是食人。
quote.en: The first of the fourth range of the Eastern Mountains is Mount Beihao, over the northern sea… There is a beast on it like a wolf with a red head and a rat's eyes; its voice is a piglet's. It is called Geju, and it eats men.

look.zh: 狼的身子，一颗红脑袋，一对老鼠的小眼睛。张嘴却是小猪的哼哼声，越哼越近。
look.en: A wolf's body, a red head, a rat's small eyes. It opens its mouth and out comes a piglet's grunting — closer with every grunt.

open.en: Hnn… hnn…

won.en: (The red head draws back into the dark; the grunting fades.)

lost.en: Hnn… it licks its lips.

quote.en: The first of the fourth range of the Eastern Mountains is Mount Beihao… There is a bird on it like a chicken with a white head, rat's feet and tiger's claws. It is called Qique, and it too eats men.

look.zh: 一只白头的鸡，脚是老鼠的，爪子却是老虎的。在地上刨一下，石头上便是三道白印。
look.en: A white-headed fowl on rat's feet, with tiger's claws. One scratch at the ground leaves three white grooves in the stone.

open.en: Kuk — kuk-kuk —

won.en: (Flapping its stubby wings, it hops down the cliff.)

lost.en: (It whets its claws on the stone.)

_likes: What a creature will take from the bag to walk with the player: 人参 for the man-eaters (形如人), 玉鱼 for the bird that fills the sea, a bell for the drum god, 齐盐 for the sea beast, 齐纨 for the pearl pig, 灵芝 for 夫诸 as the prologue has it.
_lean: How it fights, at the player's own realm and step: `lean` moves its numbers about a quarter — hide (厚皮), ward (避法), quick (迅), fierce (猛) — and `pattern` is what it does, turn after turn, cycled from a start the day draws: strike 击 · cast 法术 · gather 蓄 · guard 护体 · armor 甲. A made world writes neither: its id draws them.
_drops: What a subdued creature leaves besides its 妖丹 (which every win gives, by the realm it was met at): one catalog item, the 天材地宝 this creature carries. A made world may leave it out.
_says: What the beast says in a fight, in its own voice from its heritage (redesign-v2 § 五): `open` when the fight starts, `won` when the player wins (it yields), `lost` when the player loses (its last word). Terse, archaic, at most 24 characters in Chinese; no numbers, no game terms. `quote` is the book describing it — never its speech. A 传闻 finale's `boss` lines replace these for that fight.
_decks: 每只妖的十二张牌就是它的人格 (design.md § 斗法 v3)。十二张是 PvE 的硬顶：抽空即力竭遁走 —— 一场绝不会拖过十回合。八张是第一版，闸发现那样它在被打退之前就先抽空了（2026-09-18：55–66% 的仗打成了平局）。
_signatures: 杀招 (battle.js § 杀招)：它掉到一半气血时蓄力 —— 下一回合不出牌（它阵前的照样出手），页面写明将落下的点数 —— 再下一回合放出，一场一次。伤害先打护主。效果只用封闭词表。数值是闸量过的（2026-09-23）：会读场的赢约 84%、输约 2% —— 它是一场仗的高潮，不是一堵墙。量出来的另一件事：五回合、照剧本出牌的妖，打到杀招时胜负多半已定，所以真正的取舍在仗外（带什么牌、克哪一行、碰不碰它）。
_elite: 精英 (his, 2026-09-23)：固定在世界里、地图与妖卡上一直标着 —— 选择是去不去、带着多少伤去。它满气血上阵（不打七折），赢了修为灵石加倍、留两张牌。雷神与夔，山海经里神一级的。
_hunt: 不打重复的怪 (Hanli, 2026-10-15: 「要确保有足够的怪……不要打重复的怪」; world.mjs poolBeast). A pool's entry may wait for a 回 (`from`: a 回 id — drawn once the save has reached it in the book's order) and keep to an hour (`when`: night or day; night is `night` [from, to) in the hours of the day). The draw never deals one of the last `memory` beasts fought at that place while the pool holds more than those (one is always left), and weighs a beast he has never fought `fresh` times. A pool may say its own `memory` and `fresh`. Every beast fought by any door is kept in `state.beasts` (met, won, first day) — 图鉴 reads it, and a stretch's card counts how many of its beasts are met.
_loot: 不拿重复的物品 (Hanli, 2026-10-15; arms.mjs lootOf). `loot` on a creature: the table a beast of the wild (a pool's, a haunt's) leaves ONE thing from on each win, beside its `drops` — `[{item, w, n?, dup?}]`. A thing he never had (`state.found`, kept by every door that stows) weighs `loot_rules.fresh` times; the road's finds are weighed the same way (road.mjs). A one-off (the item's `once`) he has had comes as something useful instead: the row's `dup` (`{item, n}` or `{wealth}`), else the thing's own market price (`sell`) in 灵石, as if sold where it lay. Stackable things (herbs, hides, ores) come again as they are: they are spent at the furnace, the 饭桶 and the shops.
